mapper.sql: SELECT p.id AS "projectId", p.project_code AS "projectCode", p.project_name AS "projectName", p.engineering_project AS "engineeringProject", p.client_unit AS "clientUnit", p.close_time AS "closeTime", COALESCE(w.receivable, 0) AS "receivable", COALESCE(pa.received, 0) AS "received", COALESCE(w.receivable, 0) - COALESCE(pa.received, 0) AS "unpaidAmount", ROUND(COALESCE(pa.received, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(w.receivable, 0), 0), 1) AS "progress", ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - p.close_time)) / 86400 / 30.44, 1) AS "debtMonths", pa.last_pay_time AS "lastPayTime", cl.collect_time AS "lastCollectTime", cl.next_collect_time AS "nextCollectTime", CASE WHEN cl.id IS NULL THEN 'never' WHEN cl.next_collect_time IS NOT NULL AND cl.next_collect_time < current_date THEN 'overdue' ELSE 'calling' END AS "collectStatus" FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(amount, 0) END) AS received, MAX(pay_time) AS last_pay_time FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY project_id ) pa ON pa.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(COALESCE(external_output, 0)) AS receivable FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY project_id ) w ON w.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT id, collect_time, next_collect_time FROM proj_collection_log WHERE project_id = p.id AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY collect_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1 ) cl ON true WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status IN ('closed', 'archived') AND COALESCE(w.receivable, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(w.receivable, 0) - COALESCE(pa.received, 0) > 0.005

AND t."projectName" LIKE concat('%', #{projectName}, '%')
AND t."projectCode" LIKE concat('%', #{projectCode}, '%')
AND t."clientUnit" LIKE concat('%', #{clientUnit}, '%')
AND t."collectStatus" = #{collectStatus}
AND t."debtMonths" >= cast(#{ageBegin} as numeric)
AND t."debtMonths" <= cast(#{ageEnd} as numeric)
AND t."closeTime" >= cast(#{closeTimeBegin} as timestamp)
AND t."closeTime" <= cast(#{closeTimeEnd} as timestamp)

) t WHERE 1=1
AND t."clientUnit" LIKE concat('%', #{clientUnit}, '%')
GROUP BY t."clientUnit" ORDER BY SUM(t."unpaidAmount") DESC

SELECT p.id AS "projectId", p.project_code AS "projectCode", p.project_name AS "projectName", p.engineering_project AS "engineeringProject", p.client_unit AS "clientUnit", p.close_time AS "closeTime", COALESCE(pa.received, 0) AS "received" FROM proj_project p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(COALESCE(external_output, 0)) AS receivable FROM proj_workload WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY project_id ) w ON w.project_id = p.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, SUM(CASE WHEN payment_type = 'refund' THEN -COALESCE(amount, 0) ELSE COALESCE(amount, 0) END) AS received FROM proj_payment WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY project_id ) pa ON pa.project_id = p.id WHERE p.del_flag = '0' AND p.status IN ('closed', 'archived') AND COALESCE(w.receivable, 0) = 0
AND p.project_name LIKE concat('%', #{projectName}, '%')
AND p.client_unit LIKE concat('%', #{clientUnit}, '%')
ORDER BY p.close_time

SELECT l.id, l.project_id AS "projectId", l.collect_time AS "collectTime", l.collect_method AS "collectMethod", l.contact_name AS "contactName", l.collect_result AS "collectResult", l.next_collect_time AS "nextCollectTime", l.remark, l.create_by AS "createBy", l.create_time AS "createTime", p.project_code AS "projectCode", p.project_name AS "projectName" FROM proj_collection_log l LEFT JOIN proj_project p ON p.id = l.project_id WHERE l.project_id = #{projectId} AND l.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY l.collect_time DESC, l.id DESC
